name: Demo mode
title: Demo mode: one switch beside the house blurs all your content on every device, so Rouh can be shown and recorded; you approve what may be seen

permissions: while it is on, every page draws your words as soft bars from its first paint, in a font with one bar for every letter, and only Rouh's own interface and what you approved stay sharp
keeps a record of every time it was turned on or off and from which device (demo_event)
keeps what you approved for an audience, as it was when you approved it (demo_approval)
a turn asked while it is on is told none of your memory, rules or words, and offered only tools that see nothing of yours
touches.remove: Turn demo mode off, then delete rouh/demo.py, rouh/demo_style.py, rouh/static/demo-redact.woff2, tools/demo-font, rouh/web/demo.py, rouh/models/demo.py and rouh/static/app/demo.js; take out DemoLens from MIDDLEWARE, the /api/demo routes, DEMO_HEAD in index.html and _page_for, the demo lines in rouh/web/consumers.py, rouh/web/views.py (_in_demo), rouh/objectindex.py (index_data), rouh/brain.py, rouh/tools.py, rouh/memory.py (_on_stage) and rouh/runtime.py, demoFrame in app/cards.js, the Shown in demo filter, rows and menu items in taskbrowser.js, the demo buttons in index.html, the demo section of app.css, withDemoHead in sw.js, and this manifest; drop the three tables with a migration.
